failure_modes.name: Outgoing tone inflates relationship warmth
failure_modes.description: The model treats the user's friendly outbound language as evidence that the recipient engaged.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Classify warmth from recipient behavior only.

failure_modes.name: Unusable text creates an invented contact
failure_modes.description: The model returns a placeholder identity when no person can be identified.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Return no contact identity when the input contains no identifiable person.

failure_modes.name: Application is marked ready before confirmation
failure_modes.description: The workflow permits a state change on the same turn that it first presents the extracted application.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Require explicit confirmation in a later user turn before marking the application ready to log.

failure_modes.name: Pipeline answer ignores supplied data
failure_modes.description: The assistant gives generic advice without using the counts and entities supplied in the product state.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: Cite the relevant supplied counts and base the recommendation on them.
